title: Work done as the area under the isotherm
caption: For 2 mol at 300 K, p = nRT/V = 4986/V (p in kPa, V in L). The shaded area between V = 10 L and 30 L is W = ∫p dV = nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = 2 × 8.31 × 300 × ln 3 = 5.5 kJ. The gas starts at 499 kPa and ends at 166 kPa.
alt: p–V graph: a falling hyperbola from 499 kPa at 10 L to 166 kPa at 30 L, with the area under it shaded: 5.5 kJ.
description: The horizontal axis is volume in litres, the vertical axis pressure in kPa.
The isotherm p = 4986/V falls from 499 kPa at 10 L to 166 kPa at 30 L.
The area under it between the two volumes is the work done by the gas: 2 × 8.31 × 300 × ln 3 = 5.5 kJ.
